note: Route-graph ratchet baseline (no-new-rot ratchet). Each entry is the CURRENT reachable-first-party-module-count ceiling for a LOCKED FIXED_ROUTES route (the primary dev-perf 'first-party graph pressure' metric from scripts/route-graph.mjs). The gate fails when a tracked route's count grows BEYOND its ceiling and when the committed baseline raises any ceiling vs the base branch WITHOUT a matching absorb record. Counts are captured WITH the companion extension repos cloned pinned (exactly as CI does via clone-extensions) so they reproduce in CI. Regenerate with `node scripts/audit/route-graph-ratchet.mjs --write-baseline` after cloning the extensions — a ceiling should only ever be LOWERED as barrel imports are narrowed, and is never raised SILENTLY. A sanctioned raise must be ANNOTATED: a sibling `absorbs` record `route -> { from, to, reason, pr }` whose from/to exactly match the raise vs the base branch (from = the base ceiling, to = the new committed ceiling, reason = why the growth is accepted, pr = the PR carrying the absorbed change). The gate validates records strictly (malformed/stale/orphan records fail closed; a carried-forward record may not be deleted while its raised ceiling is kept) and prints a LOUD NOTICE line for every absorbed raise. The tracked route set is route-graph.mjs FIXED_ROUTES; change it there, then regenerate.

/api/a2a.reason: Forward merge of origin/main into cinatra#2815 S3 (epic #2812), the per-scope assignment runtime slice. `from` is main's OWN committed ceiling for this route at b39e96572818dba2ad60cb61495b292db95052ff; `to` is the count RE-MEASURED on the merged tree with the companion extension fleet cloned PINNED (116/116, missing 0), exactly how CI measures. MEASURED, NOT ARGUED, by scripts/audit/route-graph-ratchet.mjs --write-baseline on the merged tree in ONE environment: the merged tree measures /api/mcp 1788, /chat 1890, /api/a2a 1796, /api/llm-bridge 1806 against main's committed ceilings of 1786, 1888, 1794 and 1804 — +2 on each. The whole +2 is this branch's own, the two pure leaves this slice adds and which its pre-merge baseline already carried as a +2 over main's older ceilings: (1) packages/agents/src/effective-assigned-skills.ts — the effective-5 assignment chain over the run's immutable assignment-scope snapshot, imported statically by src/lib/agent-assigned-skills-injection.ts, which every tracked graph already reaches through the assigned-skill tier of src/lib/agents-store.ts; (2) src/lib/assistant-assigned-skills-delivery.ts — the assistant delivery seam together with the one thread read it needs, reached from the assistant runtime. Nothing of main's is folded into this raise: main's own growth since this branch's merge-base is already inside main's committed ceilings, which is why the merged absolute counts are +2 over them and no longer +2 over the older ceilings this branch's pre-merge baseline named. The growth is ADDITIVE: no module leaves any route's reachable set. NARROWING IS UNAVAILABLE — scripts/route-graph.mjs counts a dynamic import() specifier as exactly the same first-party graph pressure as a static one, so deferring either edge would not lower the measured count, and the seam's thread read is already folded INTO the seam module rather than kept as a second leaf. /sign-in reaches none of it and measures 163 on the merged tree, below the 223 ceiling it carries, so it keeps main's committed ceiling and main's own cinatra#2988 record UNEDITED — a forward merge neither raises nor moves an untouched route's ceiling. The PR 3143 records main committed for these four routes, and this branch's own pre-merge PR 3414 records, are RETIRED BY THIS RAISE, the one lifecycle the gate allows for an annotation whose ceiling moves.
